Please provide only the correct answer in its simplest form, without any additional text or explanation.

Both a cashier and a psychologist agreed to help raise money for their local library. Though the cashier was really helpful in the organization and running of several different events and raised a ton of money in the end, the psychologist was more trouble than they were worth and ended up mixing up dates, forgetting when they needed to complete different tasks, and really just couldn't do anything helpful at all. Who is incompetent?
A. The psychologist
B. Can't be determined
C. The cashier
